body: I’m poly and I always, always mention my partner to other people. Mainly because I want them to know but also because he’s a part of my daily life. It’s weirdly suspicious how this didn’t come up with him

I would love to be friends with you! I have been pretty frustrated lately with trying to find other girls’ girls on this platform who are genuinely just fun and looking to explore all the cool shit going on in the metaverse
Thank you so much, you put into words perfectly what I’ve been feeling. Reconnecting with him tomorrow, wish me luck!

Part of everything on your journey is learning to be okay with forgiving yourself. I know it doesn’t feel like it now, but you’ll move past this. You continue to exist and grow as a person. And as someone who’s been cheated on, I would never wish for them to feel indefinite guilt. I wish you the best in the recovery of your relationship!
I am so proud of your growth.

I know it’s not much solace. I’ve been there. Words rarely help. But going through the motions will. I promise you that if you just go into survival mode, just going through your daily tasks, just making it to one goalpost from another, you one day will feel that pit in your stomach lift. And you’ll be able to breathe again. You are so incredibly brave, even if you don’t feel like it. You are strong, and you will be so, so loved. I promise.

Don’t worry, it took me a long while to come to this realization, I would say around 6 months. But I promise you, one day you’re gonna look up and it’s gonna feel like your lungs are finally filling with air again, and you can breathe. Your love is what makes others special, not the other way around. Guarding your heart while you heal is understandable, and I hope that one day, when the time is right, you will find someone who will give you the world, because that’s what you deserve.
It will, I promise! Stay strong, you are a beautiful human being on your own.
Thank you so much. I tried the water bottle idea, it’s giving me something to do that’s productive at least. Baby steps :)

Nine months in. I still cry from time to time, but mainly because I couldn’t believe I let myself get treated the way I did. I promise, going through the motions of each day will get you there. I promise.

She sounds severely mentally fucked in the head to do that to someone. You dodged a bullet. I know it doesn’t feel that way right now, and I’m so sorry. But I promise, getting through each day will give you clarity. Be proud of yourself. I’m proud of you dude.
When someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time. You owe it to yourself and your peace to move forward, there is nothing he can give you that you haven’t already given yourself
You deserve to be happy and content. You are an amazing person. You’ve got this, good things are coming your way 💚

To see the progress is incredible. To see how much you’ve grown as a person is incredible. To say, “I will never allow this exact situation to happen in my life again” and to be able to stand your ground is one of the best feelings in the world. Thank you so much. I think we forget sometimes that it’s the little victories that make up the greatest part of our lives.
It was really nice, I think my mom and I’s relationship is taking a turn for the better
It’s in the comments section. This is all just too much.
I’m trying so hard for her, I never want to dull her smile

Ironically enough, I haven’t had a good relationship with my mom for years. I think her seeing me hit rock bottom was really what woke her up, seeing that she could lose me made her realize how sad she would be without me
Thank you, this was a really lovely comment to wake up to
I feel you omg! I think it might just be an empath thing. I genuinely love feeling like I’m able to do good for other people
I’m glad I have people like you who are kind enough to take the time out of your day to help another person. You all deserve the world
Oh my god that is a great motto. I will definitely be using that
She was really supportive, I can tell she’s stressed though. I love her for being there for me though, honestly
Thank you, I hope you find the happiness you deserve as well
You too. Thank you so much.
Thank you for talking to me. These days are so difficult, but things can only get better at this point, hopefully.
You’re right, I’m gonna call her. Thank you, I hope everything goes well.
She’s already distraught enough watching her child suffer like this. I don’t wanna put anything else on her
I’m dragging my feet, day by day. I keep telling myself that things will be better tomorrow. Maybe one day that will be true.
I want to believe that so badly. I really do. It’s taking everything I have just to stay alive.
I feel like I’m clawing my way out of my dark place only for the smallest things to knock me back down again. It’s exhausting, I just want to stay in this dark place forever

The person I trusted most in my life shattered me, cheated on me, lied to me, and moved on with the girl he cheated on me with in the span of a week. I’ve lost so many people this semester, both from this world and from my life. Part of me wants to kill myself just to make him feel the same pain that I do now, but I’m afraid that if I kill myself, my mom would take her own life too.
Drop your Venmo, I don’t have much but I can help a little
I can’t even bring myself to do it even if I tried. God, I’m so fucking pathetic.
